description: Electron packages web pages as a desktop app. It has a main process for app windows and a renderer for the page. Learn a small local window and a narrow, safe bridge between the two sides. Use a local Electron project with electron installed as a dev dependency and main.cjs as its main file. Run with npx electron . after creating package.json and index.html. These APIs do not run in a web-page playground.
versionNote: Uses current Electron main/preload/renderer separation with context isolation and sandboxing.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to change the window width to 900
Learn to find the path joined to __dirname
Learn to try a link in your local page and observe the policy
learningObjectives: Learn to change the window width to 900
Learn to find the path joined to __dirname
Learn to try a link in your local page and observe the policy
